issues: Pre-existing non-blocking React hydration warning in console: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' / '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' caused by an external editor tracker wrapping with style={display:'contents'}. Same warning reported in iteration_111 — not introduced by this feature.

critical_code_review_comments: OrphanedExecutivesModal.jsx L67: toast message computes 'r.projects_created + r.projects_assigned' WITHOUT defaults — if either field is undefined the rendered string becomes 'NaN proy.'. In this test both were 0 so it worked, but recommend coalescing: ((r.projects_created||0)+(r.projects_assigned||0)).

OrphanedExecutivesModal.jsx L63: same total computation uses '|| 0' on each field correctly. The inconsistency between L63 (defensive) and L67 (not defensive) is a small bug waiting for a partial payload.

AdminUsers.jsx L107 & L418: orphanModalOpen mounted unconditionally but only triggered behind currentUser.role==='admin' gate — OK. Consider also gating the <OrphanedExecutivesModal/> mount itself to fully eliminate any chance a non-admin could open it via devtools.

OrphanedExecutivesModal.jsx L78-80: sortedActive filters by is_active !== false, but does NOT exclude the orphan user_id itself or admin-only users. Not blocking — the GET /admin/users API already returns the right pool — but worth a defensive comment.
